question: Will US CPI inflation (CPI-U, all items, year-over-year, NSA) for October 2026 top September’s 3.7%?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The annual inflation rate for the United States for October 2026 (CPI-U, all items, not seasonally adjusted), as first published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics on 10 Nov 2026 (release expected between 13:30 UTC and 14:30 UTC that day), is strictly higher than 3.7% (the September 2026 rate), compared at one decimal.
- "No": That first published rate is 3.7% or lower.

Clarifications:
- Use the headline all-items year-over-year rate as first published, not core inflation and not a later revision.
